== Summary ==
Slip “Probe Telemetry” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (594, 211, 1106, 496)). Version [[Probe Telemetry (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
